Cabanatuan City continues to champion child welfare and development as it proudly receives the 𝙎𝙚𝙖𝙡 𝙤𝙛 𝘾𝙝𝙞𝙡𝙙-𝙁𝙧𝙞𝙚𝙣𝙙𝙡𝙮 𝙇𝙤𝙘𝙖𝙡 𝙂𝙤𝙫𝙚𝙧𝙣𝙖𝙣𝙘𝙚 for passing the 2023 Child-Friendly Local Governance Audit.

During the 2023 Seal of Child-Friendly Local Governance Regional Awarding Ceremony held on February 18, 2025, Ma’am Vanessa accepted the prestigious award on behalf of the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) Cabanatuan.

The trophy bears the inscription:

"𝗟𝗲𝘁 𝗶𝘁 𝗯𝗲 𝗸𝗻𝗼𝘄𝗻 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗖𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗻𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗻 𝗖𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗡𝘂𝗲𝘃𝗮 𝗘𝗰𝗶𝗷𝗮, 𝗶𝘀 𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗦𝗲𝗮𝗹 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗱-𝗙𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗹𝘆 𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗚𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗽𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟯 𝗖𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗱-𝗙𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗹𝘆 𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗚𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗔𝘂𝗱𝗶𝘁."

This recognition reaffirms Cabanatuan City’s unwavering commitment to ensuring a safe, nurturing, and inclusive environment where children can thrive. Congratulations to the CSWDO and the entire city for this well-deserved achievement!

Isang mahalagang pulong ang isinagawa sa Philippine Center for Postharvest Development and Mechanization (PhilMech) sa Science City of Muñoz, Nueva Ecija. Pinangunahan ito ng Department of Agriculture (DA) at Korea Agricultural Machinery Industry Cooperative (KAMICO) upang talakayin ang pagtatayo ng Korea Agricultural Machinery Industry Complex (KAMIC) sa Lungsod ng Cabanatuan na ginanap noong Pebrero 13, 2025.

Dumalo sa pulong si Cabanatuan City Mayor Myca Elizabeth R. Vergara kasama ang mga opisyal ng lungsod upang ipahayag ang kanilang suporta sa proyekto. Ang pagpupulong ay bahagi ng kasunduan sa pagitan ng DA, KAMICO, National Government at lokal na pamahalaan, na nilagdaan noong Oktubre 7, 2024. Layunin nitong itatag ang KAMIC, ang kauna-unahang lokal na kumpol ng paggawa ng makinaryang pang-agrikultura sa bansa, na magpapalakas sa mekanisasyon at produktibidad ng sektor ng agrikultura.

Ipinahayag ni Mayor Vergara ang suporta ng pamahalaang lungsod sa proyekto, kabilang ang pagpapabuti ng mga pampublikong imprastraktura upang masigurong magiging matagumpay ang pagpapatayo ng KAMIC. Sinabi rin niya na makakatulong ito sa mga magsasaka sa pamamagitan ng pagbibigay ng mas madaling access sa makabagong makinarya, na magpapataas ng kanilang ani at kabuhayan.

Inaasahang gaganapin ang groundbreaking ceremony ng KAMIC sa Marso 2025, na magsisilbing malaking hakbang patungo sa makabagong agrikultura at seguridad sa pagkain sa Pilipinas.

📢 Happy 30th Anniversary, PhilHealth! 🎉

This February 14, we join the nation in celebrating PhilHealth’s 30th year of dedicated service to the Filipino people. Established under Republic Act 7875 in 1995, PhilHealth has been at the forefront of providing financial protection for medical treatments and hospitalizations, ensuring that every Filipino feels secure in their health journey.

PhilHealth @ 30: Panatag Kami Dito!

The City Government of Cabanatuan is proud to celebrate this milestone with PhilHealth as we recognize its invaluable contributions to the health and well-being of our community.

Together, let us honor their 30 years of unwavering commitment to making health care accessible for every Juan!

The City Government of Cabanatuan extends its deepest appreciation to everyone who contributed to the success of the Banatu Music Fest 2025, held as part of the grand celebration of the 75th Founding Anniversary on February 3, 2025.

We sincerely thank our partners, Mayor Myca Elizabeth R. Vergara, Presiding Officer Julius Cesar "JAY" Vergara, Cong. Ria Vergara, and Cabanatuan City Tourism Development and Promotion Office for their unwavering support and work in bringing this momentous event to life.

We also express our heartfelt gratitude to our esteemed artists—Mr. Joey G, This Band, Hajji Alejandro, Sunkissed Lola, Orange & Lemons, and Nobita—for their outstanding performances that energized and captivated the people of Cabanatuan.

Most importantly, we extend our sincerest thanks to the Cabanatuenos who joined us in celebrating this special occasion. Your enthusiasm and support continue to inspire us to bring more meaningful and enjoyable events to our beloved city.

This is only the beginning—more celebrations and activities await. We look forward to seeing you in our future events as we continue to uphold the spirit of unity and festivity in Cabanatuan.

Vergara and Presiding Officer Julius Cesar "JAY" Vergara, in celebration of the 75th Founding Anniversary of Cabanatuan City, get ready for a night of unforgettable vibes as we stage the 𝗕𝗔𝗡𝗔𝗧𝗨 𝗠𝗨𝗦𝗜𝗖 𝗙𝗘𝗦𝗧 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟱 𝗙𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗗𝗜𝗙𝗙𝗘𝗥𝗘𝗡𝗧 𝗘𝗥𝗔𝗦 with 𝗛𝗮𝗷𝗷𝗶 𝗔𝗹𝗲𝗷𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗿𝗼, 𝗝𝗼𝗲𝘆 𝗚, 𝗢𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲 & 𝗟𝗲𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘀, 𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗕𝗮𝗻𝗱, 𝗦𝘂𝗻𝗸𝗶𝘀𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗟𝗼𝗹𝗮, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗡𝗼𝗯𝗶𝘁𝗮!

Kitakits po tayo ngayong February 3, 2025 sa Plaza Lucero, Cabanatuan City!

Show starts at 6PM.
